## What it does

A fixture body for the readback article. It defines the **readback**, a short written playback.

## When to use it

When a plan is settled and needs approval.

## Example request

> Read back what we agreed.

## What it requires

A settled conversation.

## What it does not authorize

Acting on the plan.

## FAQs

### Is this the published article?

No, it is a test fixture.

### Why does it exist?

To prove an original credit renders.

### Does it link anything?

It links [grilling](/skills/grilling).

## It's working when

- The playback has four parts.

## Where it fits in the workflow

Second main-flow skill of the Align stage, after [grilling](/skills/grilling).
